events.descripcion: The Heavenly Tower contains 50 stages, called Floors (階 Kai), with a wide variety of enemies including Cyclones, Enemy Cats, Advent Bosses and even event enemies from monthly and annual events. After completing a floor for the first time, the player will receive gifts including Battle Items, Catseyes, Catfruit, Tickets, Catamins, XP, Materials and Leaderships along with Hermit Cat, Masked Yulala and Master Uril upon defeating their respective counterparts on the 30th, 40th and 50th floors respectively, via the Catnip Challenges feature.

Legend Quest is a map somewhat similar to Heavenly Tower, with 48 stages known as LEVELs. Each LEVEL is a random Stories of Legend stage that provides a partially randomized lineup. All LEVELs are No Continues, and exiting a battle within 10 seconds will not refund items, Crowns or energy.

Best of the Best Milestone Edition (DL記念選抜ガチャ, Daunrōdo Kinen Senbatsu Gacha, DL Celebration Selection Gacha) is a Rare Cat Capsule event added in Version 14.6. It features Koneko along with selected Uber Rare units from the regular Rare Cat Capsule events in addition to all of the non-collab Legend Rare units.

This event contains three stages, each stage is a trip to all Growing Stage of the same difficulty labeled on each stage, in sequence: Growing Green, Growing Purple, Growing Red, Growing Blue and finally Growing Yellow, which is ended with the Catfruit Jubilee. After the player clears one Growing Stage, a message will show up to ask if the player wants to continue on the next Growing Stage. The player can play a total of six stages, and it costs 500 energy per play.

Introduced in Version 14.3 adds a new gimmick where applying status effects grant more points than killing enemies. More points will be awarded for units with fewer target Traits (not counting those gained from Talents). This rewards for this dojo are Treasure Chests, which contain exclusive Talent Orbs that can grant special abilities to the units that are given them.

It's high noon, time for a showdown!
Duel Stages Challenge (決闘チャレンジ, Kettō Charenji, Duel Challenge) is an event added in Version 11.6. It consists of all Duel Stages in a single map. Progress made in Duel Stages Challenge will reset when the event ends.
Each stage has a Cat Deploy Limit and enemy limit of 1. Taking over 15 minutes to beat any one stage will cause an Assassin Bear to spawn.

Attack of the Omens contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Three Omens. After beating a Three Omens, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. Rewards for the first completion of a Three Omens can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. The enemy layout changes after the 10th level, with the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP increasing per level.

Gigahaniwan Strikes! contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Excavation Lvs. After beating an Excavation Lv, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. The player may choose to bank up to 3 Excavation Lvs at one time by waiting for 90 minutes, allowing them to beat all 3 Lvs at one go. Rewards for the first completion of an Excavation Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 Excavation Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Le'Grim Strikes contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Rampage Lvs. After beating a Rampage Lv, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. Rewards for the first completion of a Rampage Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 Rampage Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Mega Menace contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called On Mighty Wings Lvs. After beating three On Mighty Wings Lvs, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one (may have 3 clears after 90 minutes). Rewards for the first completion of an On Mighty Wings Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 On Mighty Wings Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Baron Seal Strikes contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Red Alerts. After beating a Red Alert, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. Rewards for the first completion of a Red Alert can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 20 Red Alerts play out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Big Peng Z Strikes contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Wandering Lvs. After beating a Wandering Lv, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. Rewards for the first completion of a Wandering Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 Wandering Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Divine Archangel Strikes contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, each called Blessing. After beating a level, the player must wait for 30 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. Rewards for the first completion of a level can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 10 levels plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.

Horrorpotamus contains a total of 20 No Continues levels, called Cosmic Juggernaut Lvs. After beating three Cosmic Juggernaut Lvs, the player must wait for 90 minutes before they may proceed to the next one. (30 minutes for one available) Rewards for the first completion of a Cosmic Juggernaut Lv can include XP, Tickets, Catamins and Materials. Every 20 Cosmic Juggernaut Lvs plays out the same, but the strength magnifications and enemy base's HP are increased with each level.
